title: 2025-08-11 Edit 2
author: 0xldr
summary: This Atlas edit enables the Sky Frontier Grant and Fortification Grant which will establish the essential Sky Ecosystem Entities described in this post: Sky Ecosystem Entities and the Treasury Management Function It also modifies the Splitter to change the Sky Staking Rewards to 300,000 USDS per day, and SKY buyback to 100,000 USDS per day. Ecosystem Entity Grants Add a new subdocument of A.2 - The Support Scope . This document should be located directly after A.2.13 - Purpose System to read as follows: A.2.14 - Ecosystem Entity Grants - In the next available Executive Vote, the two Ecosystem Entity Grants, the Sky Frontier Grant and the Fortification Grant, must be paid out to the Sky Frontier Foundation and Fortification Foundation. Sky Frontier Grant Details: Sky Frontier Foundation Address: 0xca5183FB9997046fbd9bA8113139bf5a5Af122A0 USDS amount: 50,000,000 SKY amount: all SKY remaining in the Sky Pause Proxy less the Fortification Grant USDS/SKY LP amount: all UniV2 SKY/USDS LP tokens currently held by the treasury MKR amount: All MKR in the Sky Pause Proxy Additional transfers: all additional tokens and dust (ENS etc.) contained in the Sky Core Pause Proxy not part of the Fortification Grant, except for SPK. Fortification Grant details: Fortification Foundation Address: 0x483413ccCD796Deddee88E4d3e202425d5E891C6 USDS amount: 10,000,000 SKY amount: 200,000,000 If for any reason, technical or otherwise, the full amounts cannot be transferred, the Facilitators must find the best solution to transfer as many assets as possible to enable the Sky Frontier Foundation to tap into its immediate-term opportunities. Before encoding the transfers in the executive vote, the recipient addresses must be double checked and modified to the right addresses if necessary. Modify Token Rewards and Burn Engine Edit A.3.6.2 - Surplus Buffer Splitter Parameters to read as follows: A.3.6.2 - Surplus Buffer Splitter Parameters The current Surplus Buffer Splitter parameters are: • vow.hump: 1 million USDS (Threshold of Surplus buffer for Splitter to activate) • vow.bump: 10,000 USDS • splitter.hop: 2,160 seconds • 25% of Splitter allocation is set to accumulate SKY • 75% of Splitter allocation is set to reward SKY stakers • burn (the percentage of the vow.bump to be moved to the underlying flapper): 25% (WAD/4). Flapper must maintain its legacy values. The Splitter, and other buyback and staking rewards parameters must be set to ensure a SKY buyback of 100,000 USDS per day, and Staking Rewards of 300,000 USDS per day. If necessary this requirement overrides other conflicting Atlas Documents.
